Class IRSpectrum

java.lang.Object
global.thalion.ttio.Spectrum
global.thalion.ttio.IRSpectrum
public class IRSpectrum extends Spectrum
1-D infrared spectrum: wavenumber + intensity arrays plus mode (absorbance vs. transmittance), resolution and co-added scan count.

API status: Stable (v0.11, M73).

Cross-language equivalents: Objective-C TTIOIRSpectrum, Python ttio.ir_spectrum.IRSpectrum.

  • Constructor Details

    • IRSpectrum

      public IRSpectrum(double[] wavenumberValues, double[] intensityValues, int indexPosition, double scanTimeSeconds, Enums.IRMode mode, double resolutionCmInv, long numberOfScans)
      Construct an IR spectrum from parallel wavenumber and intensity arrays.
      Parameters:
      wavenumberValues - per-point wavenumbers in cm^-1
      intensityValues - per-point intensities or absorbances, parallel to wavenumberValues
      indexPosition - zero-based position in the parent AcquisitionRun
      scanTimeSeconds - scan time in seconds from run start
      mode - IR acquisition mode (TRANSMITTANCE or ABSORBANCE); null defaults to TRANSMITTANCE
      resolutionCmInv - spectral resolution in cm^-1
      numberOfScans - number of co-added scans
